items.title: No A/C
items.text:
No A/C
I installed my nest thermostat back in the winter so when testing it was difficult to test a/c vs just being cold after the heat had been off wiring it up. 

The heat has been working fine but last night when I swapped it to A/C while in bed I woke up to the house at 79. It was just continueing to dump heat into the house rather than activate the A/C and I'm not sure if I missed something during the original install or not.

[old thermostat](https://i.imgur.com/Kx7HiOr.jpg), [nest thermostat](https://i.imgur.com/yvx0ZAq.jpg), [detected equipment screen](https://i.imgur.com/xCMEb49.jpg),

Mine shows the correct temp in the house. Only for some reason when it's kicking on the central unit, it's not telling it to run the A/C so it keeps the heat on. 

I'm gonna grab a multimeter and figure out on the old unit what gets power when so I can try to figure this out.

I swapped it to rc, it detected the change and didn't burst into flames. 

However it still puts out heat when testing aircon, I tried flipping the O/B setting and doesn't change it.

Are you set to Celsius?
27c is 81f.
